label: Classic 3D — M35 hero (WebGL)
description: The four original line drawings rebuilt in 3D on their own measurements, animated like the glass versions, on the new M35 detail page hero. Hero: drawing 1 in black and white (white lines and beads, a flat black fill that only hides what is behind), still, turning with the mouse (gyroscope on phones); hover lifts the board or a tier, hover on the star spins it; the dashed drips flow. White modules, black line: the shortlist holds the same cake; Step 1 draws the data frame (rings, rays bead-first, frame) and undraws it in sequence; Step 2 lays the three rims one by one with their dashed drips, then drips them off; Step 3 builds board, tier and star and lets the frosting fall onto the top. Tuner: press T.
